blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Union of Journalists of the Philippines (NUJP) on Monday renewed its call for full accountability in the Maguindanao massacre, saying victims’ families continue to wait for the final resolution of court proceedings and the enforcement of a ruling against those convicted nearly seven years ago. Seventeen years after the Nov. 23, 2009 killings that left 58 people dead, including 32 media workers, the group said unresolved appeals continue to delay the families’ pursuit of justice despite the convictions handed down in December 2019.
